/* ===================== QUICK QUOTE DRAWER, pure CSS ===================== */
/* Driven by :target, so the sticky bar and the right edge tab open it with a
   real link. No script, and the panel stays out of the tab order while shut
   because the whole layer is visibility:hidden. */
.qm{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:95;visibility:hidden;opacity:0;
  transition:opacity .3s ease,visibility .3s}
.qm:target{visibility:visible;opacity:1}
.qm-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;display:block;background:rgba(28,27,25,.62)}
.qm-panel{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:min(470px,100%);
  background:var(--bone);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;
  padding:clamp(26px,3vw,40px) clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px) clamp(34px,4vw,48px);
  box-shadow:-20px 0 56px -22px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
  transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .36s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)}
.qm:target .qm-panel{transform:translateX(0)}
.qm-x{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;z-index:2;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid var(--line-strong);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-decoration:none;font-size:1rem;
  transition:background-color .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,color .2s ease}
.qm-x:hover{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.qm-head{margin:0 56px 22px 0}
.qm-head .h3{margin:10px 0 10px}
.qm-head .meta{font-size:.88rem;margin:0}
/* one column at this width, and the send row reads as a stacked block */
.qm .qb-form{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:20px}
.qm .field,.qm .field.c6{grid-column:1/-1}
.qm .qb-send{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:12px;padding-top:20px}
.qm .qb-send .btn{width:100%}
.qm .qb-send .fine{max-width:none}
.qm-call{margin:20px 0 0;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--ink)}
.qm-call a{color:var(--terra-deep);font-weight:600;text-underline-offset:3px}
/* on a phone it becomes a bottom sheet, which is the reachable edge there */
@media (max-width:760px){

    transform:translateY(100%);

  .qm:target .qm-panel{transform:translateY(0)}
}

/* ===================== CTA BAND, MID PAGE ================================ */
/* The page's one accent band. Everything else is bone, concrete or kiln dark,
   so putting the single terracotta on a full ground here is what makes this
   section read as lifted rather than as another panel. It also builds a ramp
   into the process section below: off white, accent, kiln dark.
   Kept deep on purpose. A lighter terracotta would push cream body copy under
   4.5:1, so the gradient tops out at #925434 and runs down to #6F3B23. */
.band{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;
  padding-top:clamp(62px,7vw,116px);padding-bottom:clamp(62px,7vw,116px);
  background:linear-gradient(164deg,#925434 0%,#83492C 54%,#6F3B23 100%)}
/* the grout line device again, this time in cream at low alpha, plus one
   darker corner so the ground is not flat */
.band::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0 1px,transparent 1px 132px),
    radial-gradient(62% 56% at 96% 96%,rgba(44,22,12,.30),transparent 66%),
    radial-gradient(52% 48% at 2% 2%,rgba(255,255,255,.07),transparent 62%)}
/* a hairline frame set in from the section edge, the way a tile field is set
   in from the wall. Drawn on its own element so no stacking context fights */
.band-rule{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;
  inset:clamp(14px,1.6vw,26px) clamp(14px,1.8vw,30px);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.17);border-radius:var(--r)}
.band-rule::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:6px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:2px}

.band-in{position:relative;display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.04fr);
  align-items:center;gap:clamp(30px,4.6vw,78px)}

/* ---- the photograph, matted in cream so it lifts off the accent ---- */
.band-shot{position:relative;margin:0;min-width:0}
.band-frame{display:block;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--r);
  background:#FBF6F1;padding:clamp(9px,1vw,14px);
  box-shadow:0 34px 70px -34px rgba(40,18,8,.72)}
.band-shot img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;
  border-radius:2px;transition:transform .6s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1)}
.band-shot:hover img{transform:scale(1.035)}


/* ---- the ask ---- */
.band-copy{min-width:0}
/* a struck tag rather than the page's plain eyebrow, so the band opens
   differently from every numbered section */
.band-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:0 0 clamp(16px,1.8vw,22px);
  padding:9px 16px 9px 13px;border-radius:999px;
  /* recessed rather than lightened: a white fill lifted the ground under the
     chip to #9F6E54, where white type is 4.35:1. A dark fill drops it to
     about #78472E and the same type reads at 7.6:1 */
  background:rgba(40,18,8,.26);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.30);
  font-size:.68rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#FFFFFF}
.band-tag i{font-size:.8rem;color:#F4D9C8}

.band-copy .h2{color:#FFFFFF;max-width:19ch}
.band-copy .body{margin-top:clamp(16px,1.8vw,22px);max-width:52ch;color:#F4E2D7}

.band-pts{list-style:none;margin:clamp(22px,2.6vw,32px) 0 0;padding:0;
  display:grid;gap:12px}
.band-pts li{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:13px;
  font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.5;color:#FBF2EC}
.band-pts i{flex:none;margin-top:.22em;font-size:.78rem;color:#F0C6AE}

/* on the accent, a terracotta fill would vanish: cream leads, outline follows */
.band-act{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:13px;margin-top:clamp(26px,3vw,38px)}
.band-act .btn-pri{background:#FBF6F1;border-color:#FBF6F1;color:var(--ink)}
.band-act .btn-pri:hover{background:#FFFFFF;border-color:#FFFFFF;color:var(--ink)}
.band-act .btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:#FFFFFF;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.52)}
.band-act .btn-ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-color:#FFFFFF;color:#FFFFFF}

@media (max-width:900px){
  .band-in{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(34px,5vw,46px)}
  .band-copy .h2{max-width:none}
}

  .band-rule{inset:10px}
  .band-act .btn{flex:1 1 100%}
}

/* ========= ASSURANCE PANEL, AT THE FOOT OF THE QUOTE DRAWER ============= */
/* Set over a photograph of the grout joints under a deep overlay, so the
   closing panel carries something of the trade instead of another flat fill.
   The image is a real <img> rather than a CSS background: it keeps its alt
   text, and it is the only way the panel survives being lifted into a CMS. */
.qm-seal{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden;
  margin-top:clamp(26px,3vw,34px);border-radius:var(--r-lg)}
/* the ground is the two trades side by side: membrane going on at the left,
   the finished joints at the right, split on a hairline. Two real images
   rather than one CSS background, so both keep their alt text on import */
.qm-seal-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-2;display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
.qm-seal-bg img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.qm-seal-bg img:last-child{border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
/* two layers: a deep wash that holds the type, and one warm corner so the
   photograph still reads as a photograph underneath it */
.qm-seal::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(74% 92% at 88% 6%,rgba(159,92,60,.44),transparent 68%),
    linear-gradient(154deg,rgba(23,20,18,.93) 0%,rgba(26,22,19,.90) 52%,rgba(20,17,15,.94) 100%)}

.qm-seal-in{position:relative;padding:clamp(20px,2.4vw,26px)}

.qm-seal-h{margin:0 0 16px;padding-bottom:15px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;
  font-size:clamp(1.18rem,3.4vw,1.42rem);line-height:1.18;color:#FFFFFF}

.qm-seal-l{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:11px}

  font-size:.87rem;line-height:1.45;color:#F2EDE8}
.qm-seal-l i{flex:none;font-size:.74rem;color:#EFC9B2}

.card-list i{flex:none;margin-top:.22em;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--terra-deep)}
.card-links{display:grid;gap:0}
.card-links a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;
  padding:12px 0;min-height:46px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);transition:color .2s ease}
.card-links a:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.card-links a:hover{color:var(--terra-deep)}
.card-links i{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--line-strong);transition:transform .22s ease,color .22s ease}
.card-links a:hover i{transform:translateX(4px);color:var(--terra-deep)}

/* ---------- tiles: a flexible card grid for children and related -------- */
.tiles{display:grid;gap:clamp(14px,1.5vw,22px)}
.tiles.c2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.tiles.c3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.tiles.c4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
/* five items, two full rows: 3 across then 2 across, no empty cell */
/* seven items: 4 across then 3 across, both rows full */
.tiles.c7{grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr))}
.tiles.c7 > *{grid-column:span 3}
.tiles.c7 > :nth-child(5),.tiles.c7 > :nth-child(6),.tiles.c7 > :nth-child(7){grid-column:span 4}
.tiles.c5{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))}
.tiles.c5 > *{grid-column:span 2}
.tiles.c5 > :nth-child(4),.tiles.c5 > :nth-child(5){grid-column:span 3}
.tile{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;
  background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  padding:clamp(20px,1.9vw,27px);text-decoration:none;
  transition:border-color .24s ease,transform .24s ease,box-shadow .24s ease}
.tile:hover{border-color:var(--concrete-deep);transform:translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow:0 26px 48px -40px rgba(28,27,25,.55)}
.tile .idx{color:var(--terra-deep)}
.tile h3{font-family:var(--display);font-optical-sizing:auto;font-size:1.22rem;
  font-weight:400;letter-spacing:-.012em;line-height:1.2;color:var(--ink);margin:0}
.tile p{margin:0;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted)}
.tile .tile-go{margin-top:auto;padding-top:12px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  font-size:.74rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--terra-deep)}
.tile .tile-go i{transition:transform .24s ease}
.tile:hover .tile-go i{transform:translateX(5px)}
.on-dark .tile{background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);border-color:var(--dark-line)}
.on-dark .tile h3{color:#fff}
.on-dark .tile p{color:var(--dark-body)}
.on-dark .tile .idx,.on-dark .tile .tile-go{color:var(--terra-lift)}
.on-dark .tile:hover{border-color:var(--dark-ctrl);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}

/* a tile that leads with an image */
.tile-img{padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.tile-img .frame img{aspect-ratio:4/3}
.tile-img .tile-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;flex:1;
  padding:clamp(18px,1.7vw,24px)}

/* ---------- spec rows: the technical detail a trade page needs ---------- */
.spec{border-top:1px solid var(--line-strong)}
.spec-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,220px) minmax(0,1fr);
  gap:clamp(14px,2.4vw,46px);padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:start}
.spec-row dt{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--terra-deep);margin:0;padding-top:3px}
.spec-row dd{margin:0;color:var(--body-ink);line-height:1.7}
.on-dark .spec{border-top-color:var(--dark-ctrl)}
.on-dark .spec-row{border-bottom-color:var(--dark-line)}
.on-dark .spec-row dt{color:var(--terra-lift)}
.on-dark .spec-row dd{color:var(--dark-body)}

/* ---------- a two up editorial block, image and copy ------------------- */
.duo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);
  gap:clamp(26px,3.6vw,70px);align-items:center}
.duo.flip .duo-fig{order:2}
.duo-fig .frame{box-shadow:0 40px 74px -56px rgba(28,27,25,.6)}
.duo-fig img{aspect-ratio:4/3;width:100%}
.duo-cap h2{margin-top:14px}
.duo-cap .body{margin-top:16px}
.duo-cap .duo-body{margin-top:16px;max-width:60ch;color:var(--muted)}
.duo-cap .duo-body p + p{margin-top:13px}
.on-dark .duo-cap .duo-body{color:var(--dark-body)}
.duo-list{list-style:none;margin:20px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:11px}
.duo-list li{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:flex-start;color:var(--body-ink);line-height:1.6}
.duo-list i{flex:none;margin-top:.26em;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--terra-deep)}
.on-dark .duo-list li{color:var(--dark-body)}
.on-dark .duo-list i{color:var(--terra-lift)}

/* ---------- a gallery strip of real work -------------------------------- */
.gal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(12px,1.3vw,20px)}
/* a gallery of one or two sits on a wider grid so a single figure is not stranded */
.gal.g1{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,7fr) minmax(0,5fr)}
.gal.g1 figure:only-child{grid-column:1}
.gal.g2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.gal .frame img{aspect-ratio:4/3;width:100%}
.gal figure{margin:0}
.gal .idx{display:block;margin-top:10px}
.gal p{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.55;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- the coverage map panel on a location page ------------------- */
.covr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.05fr);
  gap:clamp(24px,3.4vw,62px);align-items:center}
.covr-fig{min-width:0;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:var(--r-lg);padding:clamp(14px,1.4vw,22px);
  box-shadow:0 26px 54px -44px rgba(28,27,25,.5)}
.covr-fig img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:2px}
.covr-note{margin:12px 2px 0;font-size:.74rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:18px;padding:0;list-style:none}
.chips li{margin:0}
.chips a,.chips span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;
  padding:9px 15px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:100px;
  font-size:.86rem;color:var(--body-ink);text-decoration:none;background:var(--paper);
  transition:border-color .2s ease,color .2s ease,background-color .2s ease}
.chips a:hover{border-color:var(--terra);color:var(--terra-deep);background:var(--terra-wash)}
.chips i{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--terra-deep)}

/* ---------- legal and utility pages ------------------------------------ */
.legal .prose-main{max-width:76ch}
.legal .prose-main h2{font-size:clamp(1.3rem,1.1rem + .7vw,1.7rem)}
.legal-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 26px;padding:16px 0;margin-bottom:8px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  font-size:.84rem;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- a compact conversion band for internal pages ---------------- */
.mini{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,44px);
  align-items:center;padding:clamp(24px,2.6vw,38px) 0;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-strong)}
.mini h2{font-family:var(--display);font-optical-sizing:auto;font-size:clamp(1.35rem,1.1rem + .9vw,1.9rem);
  font-weight:300;letter-spacing:-.016em;line-height:1.16;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 7px;max-width:24ch}
.mini p{margin:0;font-size:.94rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted);max-width:56ch}
.mini-act{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:11px}
.on-dark .mini{border-color:var(--dark-ctrl)}
.on-dark .mini h2{color:#fff}
.on-dark .mini p{color:var(--dark-body)}

/* ---------- responsive --------------------------------------------------- */
@media (max-width:1180px){
  .prose{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,280px);gap:36px}
  .tiles.c4{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media (max-width:1024px){
  .phero-in{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px}
  .phero h1{max-width:20ch}
  .phero-fig{max-width:620px}
  .prose{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}
  .aside{position:static}
  .covr{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:30px}
  .duo{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:28px}
  .duo.flip .duo-fig{order:0}
  .tiles.c4,.tiles.c3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  /* 3 then 4 reads better in a narrow two up, so run 6 across then one full width */
  .tiles.c7{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .tiles.c7 > *,.tiles.c7 > :nth-child(5),.tiles.c7 > :nth-child(6){grid-column:span 1}
  .tiles.c7 > :nth-child(7){grid-column:span 2}
  /* flip the rhythm: 2 across then 3 across, so both rows still fill */
  .tiles.c5 > :nth-child(1),.tiles.c5 > :nth-child(2){grid-column:span 3}
  .tiles.c5 > :nth-child(3),.tiles.c5 > :nth-child(4),.tiles.c5 > :nth-child(5){grid-column:span 2}
  .gal{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .gal.g1{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,3fr) minmax(0,2fr)}
  .mini{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .pkeys{grid-template-columns:1fr;border-top:0}
  .pkeys li{padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
  .pkeys li + li{padding-left:0;border-left:0}
  .tiles.c2,.tiles.c3,.tiles.c4,.tiles.c5,.tiles.c7{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .tiles.c7 > *,.tiles.c7 > :nth-child(7){grid-column:span 1}
  .tiles.c5 > *,.tiles.c5 > :nth-child(5){grid-column:span 1}
  .gal,.gal.g1,.gal.g2{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .spec-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:7px;padding:16px 0}
  .mini-act .btn{width:100%}
}
